levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: One or more of the five required pieces (budget, meal plan, maintenance judgments, transport plan, disruption response) is missing from the review.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: All five pieces are present and assembled into one coherent review.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The review explicitly shows how the pieces connect (for example, how the disruption affected the budget and meal plan together).

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The final reflection claims the plan had no real weaknesses.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The final reflection names a specific, genuine weak point.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The named weak point is the same one an outside reader would plausibly flag first, showing accurate self-assessment.

lookFors: All five month-long artifacts are represented in the final review.
The guardian confirmation (or self-review) is distinct from the learner's own summary.
The honest weak-point statement is specific, not a generic 'nothing's perfect.'

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
